title: OMW Pronouns
name: omw-pronoun
tagline: Pronouns as bundles of features, across languages

main.description: The pronoun concepts and their features, with their hierarchy, definitions and words in every language.

provenance.description: Provenance records tracing every data point back to its source and original identifier.

about.intro:
OMW Pronouns is a multilingual wordnet of pronouns and other pro-forms. Every concept is a bundle of features (person, number, deixis, ...) with a compositional code, shared by all languages and proposed to the Collaborative Interlingual Index. Words come from NTUMC, the TUFS Basic Vocabulary, Parabank Pronoun and Haspelmath's indefinite-pronoun series.

Source and data on GitHub; the hierarchy can also be browsed as feature diagrams in the hierarchy browser.
about.citation: If you use OMW Pronouns, please cite Seah and Bond (2014) for the analysis of pronouns.  For the interface, please cite Maudslay and Bond (2026).
about.languageData: Concepts and words come from NTUMC, the TUFS Basic Vocabulary, Parabank Pronoun (Greenhill et al.) and Haspelmath (1997).

publications: Yu Jie Seah and Francis Bond (2014) Annotation of Pronouns in a Multilingual Corpus of Mandarin Chinese, English and Japanese. In Proceedings of the 10th Joint ACL-ISO Workshop on Interoperable Semantic Annotation (ISA-10).
